title: Open Mic and Jam @ The Wormhole

backline: Full Backline Drums Bass Guitar Keyboard PA System Microphone
event_venue_information:
The Wormhole - Savannah's Favorite Neighborhood Dive and Music Venue

The Wormhole Neighborhood Pub and Music Venue has become a beloved institution in Savannah's Starland Design District. Located at 2307 Bull Street near Starland Yard the venue describes itself as your local watering hole with 1.21 Jigawatts of Entertainment. Decked out in dark space-themed decor The Wormhole maintains authentic dive bar character while providing professional music programming seven nights a week.

Best Open Mic in Savannah

The Wormhole has been voted Best Open Mic by Connect Savannah readers. Every Monday from 8pm to 2:30am the venue hosts open mic and jam sessions that welcome bands and singer-songwriters of all genres. The format accommodates newly formed bands looking for stage experience professionals working on new songs musicians looking to jam with others touring bands routing through and anyone wanting to be part of Savannah's music scene.

Professional Backline and Recording

The Wormhole provides full backline equipment including drums bass guitar and keyboard. This professional setup removes barriers to participation - musicians can show up with just their instrument or voice. Sets run 10-15 minutes for solo acts and 15 minutes for bands with option to sign up again non-consecutively. Live multi-track recordings are available subject to availability - performers can text the sound engineer at 912-507-3599 to register ahead and arrange recordings.

Wednesday Jam Sessions

Every other Wednesday from 8pm to 2:30am The Wormhole hosts jam sessions only - no open mic sign-ups. These sessions focus purely on collaborative jamming allowing musicians to play together spontaneously. The alternating Wednesday schedule provides variety in programming while maintaining consistent musical community throughout the week.

Live Music Every Weekend

Beyond open mic Mondays and jam Wednesdays The Wormhole features concerts and local bands every Friday and Saturday night. The programming spans all genres reflecting the venue's commitment to diverse musical expression. The music stage and professional sound system ensure quality performance regardless of genre. Artists traveling through Savannah specifically come to The Wormhole knowing they will find supportive audiences and professional treatment.

Dive Bar Authenticity

The Wormhole proudly maintains dive bar authenticity in an era of increasingly gentrified Savannah. We are not pretentious and we don't try to be something we're not - we are just Wormhole according to staff. The venue features pool tables pinball darts and billiards alongside the music. The casual atmosphere and lack of cover charges for most events make The Wormhole accessible to all. Regular patrons describe counting on friendly faces behind the bar and feeling at home.

Starland Design District Location

Located in the Starland Design District south of Forsyth Park The Wormhole sits in a neighborhood known for art galleries creative businesses and younger demographics. The location near the intersection of Bull Street and 39th Street positions the venue as the only music option in this area creating a neighborhood gathering place. The district has become increasingly vibrant with The Wormhole serving as a cultural anchor.
